```python
import os
import sys
from cyhole.helius import Helius
from cyhole.helius.schema import PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody

api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")

wallet_address = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "11111111111111111111111111111111"

helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)

body = PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody(owner_address=wallet_address)
response = helius.client.post_get_assets_by_owner(body)

print(f"Total assets: {response.result.total}")
print(f"Assets on page: {len(response.result.items)}")
print()

for asset in response.result.items:
    print(f"ID: {asset.id}")
    if asset.content and asset.content.metadata:
        print(f"  Name: {asset.content.metadata.name}")
        print(f"  Symbol: {asset.content.metadata.symbol}")
    print(f"  Owner: {asset.ownership.owner}")
    print()
```
